remarks: Values to be checked against the Turkish regulation
text: Workers exposure to chemicals shall be kept below the occupational exposure limits of the Turkish regulation on chemical agents (which follow the EU indicative limits): ammonia 14 mg/m3 (20 ppm) as 8 hour average and 36 mg/m3 (50 ppm) as 15 minute value; chlorine 1.5 mg/m3 (0.5 ppm) and 2.9 mg/m3 (1 ppm) as 15 minute value; nitrogen dioxide 0.96 mg/m3 (0.5 ppm) and 1.91 mg/m3 (1 ppm); hydrogen sulphide 5 ppm and 10 ppm; the design shall minimise release and shall provide the fixed gas detection of section 10.
